## `neuro.iterator.next`

Instance method on `Iterator.prototype`. Variadic items live under `__0`.



## Signatures

```ts
next(input: { iterator: <receiver>; __0: [] | [TNext]; prompt?: string }): Promise<IteratorResult<T, TReturn>>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Iterator.prototype.next` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
